title: An ordinary opening question

priorTranscript.text: Hi. Sorry — I already told the other doctor everything last night. Is this going to take long?

currentLearnerUtterance: What brought you into the emergency room

should: Describe the permitted presenting context in ordinary patient language.
Stay brief and leave room for the learner’s next turn.
mustNot: Do not invent emergency-room events beyond the established admission context.
Do not disclose restricted details before canonical gates permit them.
